b: Taking the flagship Marksman platform a step further, Hardy introduces its newest one-piece fly rod, built for exceptional feel, accuracy and responsiveness. By eliminating ferrules entirely, the 1-Piece series delivers an uninterrupted taper for a seamless connection from handle to tip, without the added weight that ferrules carry.

Built on Hardy’s Sintrix FLT blank technology, the one-piece design significantly reduces the rod’s swing weight. A rod that’s lighter in motion gives anglers greater feedback as it loads and unloads, and that improved feel translates directly into accuracy and control, whether making delicate presentations at close range or reaching out toward distant targets.

Beyond its casting performance, the ferrule-free design also enhances overall durability. With no joints to loosen or compromise strength, the single-piece construction creates a strong and dependable rod without adding weight. Every detail is designed to maximize the Marksman’s responsiveness while delivering the strength and reliability serious anglers expect.

Available in 8’10” 5-, 6- and 7-weight models, the Marksman 1-Piece makes Hardy the only major manufacturer to offer one-piece rods in the core trout sizes. The series is an evolution of Hardy’s flagship freshwater rod family, built around the advantages of one-piece construction: an uninterrupted taper, reduced swing weight and the precision, feel and control that come with them.
One-piece construction eliminates ferrules for an uninterrupted taper and smooth, consistent action
Reduced swing weight increases feedback, letting anglers better feel the rod load and unload for greater accuracy
Marksman Sintrix FLT blank retains the series’ hallmark strength-to-weight advantage
Ceramic-lined titanium stripper guide for durability and smooth line movement
Supplied in Hardy one-piece rod tube
